nodes.label: Lambda-9 as a category of transitions
nodes.rationale: Lambda-8 cannot be iterated because its source has four coordinates and its target three — the asymmetry is a missing spin. Giving the target its own multiplicity 2S' <= g under exactly the source's constraint forms makes all 1,654 targets legal sources; composition then closes on all 41,682 pairs and is associative on all 842,206 triples with zero failures, sharpening the record's 8,434-triple sample to the whole population.

nodes.label: Composition is time — an order between cells, not a stamp
nodes.rationale: b after a runs a's source to b's target and transfers min(q_a, q_b) — no more than was taken and no more than arrives — so time appears as the composition order of the lattice rather than as a coordinate stamped on a cell. Prior art: Eilenberg & Mac Lane 1945, Mac Lane 1971.

nodes.label: Composability as a strictly finer grading than exactness
nodes.rationale: Lambda-9 is the only composing stage: every axis above the ninth attaches to one end or to the joint object, so the shapes part company. Composability is lost at axis 10 — one step before exactness — because v is a counting coordinate that closes exactly and still has no source counterpart, so an axis can be exact and not composable but never the reverse, and the tower carries three gradings rather than two.
